title: openapi-editor
summary: View and edit OpenAPI specs stored in the integration_models MongoDB collection

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Returns id, title, version for every document in integration_models

output.name: models
output.description: Array of { id, title, version, versionId }

methods.name: getModel
methods.summary: Get a single OpenAPI model document by id
methods.description: Returns the full OpenAPI 3.0 document for the given _id

methods.name: validateModel
methods.summary: Validate an OpenAPI document without saving it
methods.description: Runs the document through swagger-parser validation and returns any errors

methods.name: createModel
methods.description: Validates the incoming spec, confirms no model with the same versionId (title+version) already exists, then creates it via Itential Platform's own POST /integration-models - the sanctioned create call. Does NOT create an Integration instance; use Itential's normal process to add an instance against the new model afterward.

output.name: result
output.description: { success: boolean, steps: array, versionId: string, model: string, modelId: string, errors: array }

methods.name: getUpdateImpact
methods.summary: Preview what saving this model would affect, without changing anything
methods.description: Read-only: returns the model's associated Integration instances (if any) and a full backup payload, so the UI can warn the user and offer a backup download before Save runs the delete/reapply/recreate process.

output.name: impact
output.description: { versionId, model, associatedIntegrations: array, backup: object }

methods.name: saveModel
methods.summary: Update an integration model via Itential's own sanctioned process
methods.description: Validates the incoming spec, then performs the delete-dependent-instances / delete-model / reapply-model / recreate-instances sequence via Itential Platform's own Integration Model and Integrations REST APIs (Basic auth) - NOT a direct Mongo write - since Platform 6 has no supported in-place update for a model with existing instances.

output.name: result
output.description: { success: boolean, steps: array, versionId: string, errors: array, backup: object }

methods.name: testRequest
methods.summary: Execute a test HTTP call against a real target server, server-side
methods.description: Runs an ad hoc request (built from the OpenAPI document's servers/paths) from this app's own cog process rather than the browser, so it is never subject to browser CORS restrictions. Supports None/Basic/Bearer/OAuth2 auth overrides, an optional curl execution path, and skipping TLS certificate verification.
